metadata.description: revgate — human-in-the-loop review for GitHub Copilot CLI.

plugins.name: revgate-copilot
plugins.description: Human-in-the-loop, GitHub-style review for GitHub Copilot CLI. Manual-first: /revgate-review and /revgate-plan run on demand, with one automatic exception — plan mode is gated via preToolUse. Requires the `revgate` bin on PATH (`npm install -g .` from a clone, or `npm link`); the gate stays dormant until it is.
